name: Boudin Sausage Fritters
whyItWorks: Deep-fried breaded pork and rice boudin balls carry Cajun cayenne spice, diced aromatics, and heavy fryer oil that can trigger cramping and urgency.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid during flares. In solid remission, share a single fritter to test spice and grease tolerance, and skip the spicy Cajun dipping aioli.
flareEmergencySwap: Order the Sautéed Gulf Shrimp and Grits (ask for mild/no Cajun spice) or plain white rice with roasted chicken instead.
watchOuts: Diced onion/bell pepper in boudin filling
